metadata.case_name: CHI YUK PUI v. GRACE MIND CORPORATION LTD T/A TSUNO JAPANESE RESTAURANT

source: The report from the Accident & Emergency Department of Kwong Wah Hospital, which he attended that night after the accident, stated that he fell with resulting right wrist contusion and that, on examination, his right wrist was swollen and tender.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other parts of wrist or hand

injuries.description: residual subluxation / suspected DRUJ instability of right distal radio-ulnar joint (DRUJ)
source: X-ray of the right wrist found widened distal radio-ulnar joint ("DRUJ").
Clinical examination revealed pain on wrist supination and X-ray revealed no definite fracture but suspected DRUJ instability.
Dr Tio found, on his examination, that the plaintiff suffered from residual subluxation and tenderness over right DRUJ, with minimal reduction in the range of movement.

manifestations.description: right wrist was swollen and tender
residual intermittent pain over his right wrist upon paper cutting for over 5 to 10 minutes and upon maintaining a stationary position for over 5 to 10 minutes
The pain occurred once or twice a week, and lasted a few minutes
occasional clicks over his right wrist
minimal reduction in the range of movement
feeling of tiredness of his right wrist after working for about 5 to 10 minutes (later improved to 15 to 20 minutes)

treatments_received: He was admitted to the Orthopaedics Unit for further management.
He was provided with a dynacast
attended the outpatient department for treatment until March 2012
received physiotherapy treatment from November 2011 to January 2012
Pre-trial Loss of Earnings & MPF awarded $71,703.45
